title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → PositionBudget

source_tables.description: Position master (budget FTE, budget amount per position).
Position budget. Funding source, chartfield allocation for each position.
Department budget by earnings. Budget amounts by department, account, fund for compensation.
Position funding detail (Higher Ed add-on). Funding splits across chartfields for a single position.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Annual budgeted compensation for the position.
Array of funding splits: {fund_code, department, account, percent, amount}. A single position can be funded from multiple sources (e.g., 50% state funds, 30% grant, 20% auxiliary).

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from PS_LEDGER_KK (ENCUMB ledger for position's chartfield)
attribute_mappings.transformation: Actual salary encumbrance against the position budget.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from PS_LEDGER (ACTUALS for position's chartfield)

notes: Position budgeting bridges HCM and Financials. Higher ed institutions with position management use it to control headcount and compensation spending. Split funding (one position funded from multiple chartfields) is extremely common — a professor might be 60% state-funded instruction, 30% grant-funded research, 10% department service. The PS_HP_POS_FUND_DTL table (Higher Ed add-on) handles these splits.
